Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses i) Mode of Tendering/Procurement:- Custom Bid & Limited Tender. Note:- This Tender is meant for the approved Eight (08) Limited vendors only approved by NALCO against this particular tender. Therefore, the contract shall be awarded to the approved Limited bidders or their a uthorized dealers only. The offers of other bidders shall not be considered for evaluation against the tender and shall be rejected. ii) The scope of the bidder comprises of Supply + Supervision of ICT i.e. the Installation & Co mmissioning of Pump is in the scope of NALCO under Supervision of the Supplier. iii) Delivery Schedule/Milestone:- a) The Time Period within which the materials shall be developed:- Within 180 days . b) The Time period required for carrying out the ICT job by NALCO (under the supervi sion of the supplier) :- Within 10 days.

c) The Time Period within which Installation & Commissioning activity shall be compl eted by NALCO (for which the Supplier has to depute their representative to NALCO C PP site to carry out the Supervision job) at NALCO CPP site from the date of receipt of the materials:- Within 30 days. iv) Payment Term:- The 90% payment shall be released to the Supplier within 10 days of receipt and acceptance of the materials at NALCO CPP site & balance 10% shall be re leased to the Supplier within 10 days of successful Installation & Commissioning of t he item to ensure smooth fitment & interchangeability. The Installation of Pump is in the scope of NALCO under Supervision of the Supplier. However, the payment of GST is subject to reflection of the party's Invoice in GSTR-2 A/Annex-2 (GST new return) of NALCO. v) RESTRICTION UNDER RULE 144(XI) OF GFR, 2017:- The vendors are requested to go through the Rule 14 4(xi) of GFR 2017 and order No: 6/18/2019-PPD, dtd: 23/07/2020 & 24/07/2020 and confirm to have compli ed the same. vi) LOCAL CONTENT OF PRODUCT:- The bidders are requested to go through the GoI Order No: P-45021/2/2 017-PP (BE-II), DTD: 16.09.2020 or amended thereafter for the purpose of Purchase Preference on the basi s of Local Content and submit the declaration accordingly. vii) The bidders are requested to furnish the declaration towards implementation of the Integrity as per the format attached along with the NIT. viii) Contact Details:- The contact details is as follows:- a) Purchase Executive:- Mr. Hrudananda Sahoo Email: hrudananda.sahoo@nalcoindia.co.in Mobile:- 9437585716 b) Stores Executive (i.e. consignee):- Mr. Siba Behera Contact No-9437350693 Email: sibaprasad.behera@nalcoindia.co.in c) Technical Executive:- Mr. Goutam Kumar Nayak Contact No-9437962968 . 4.
